newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa plans Oct 4/11 Yankee bond roadshow.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa plans Oct 4/11 Yankee bond roadshow.

text.p: South African officials led by Finance Minister Trevor Manuel will visit nine locations in the United States from October 4 to 11 to promote the country's planned Yankee bond issue.

"Should market circumstances permit, a Yankee issue should follow the roadshow. The amount, maturity and pricing will be determined after we have had feedback from the American investor community," the finance ministry said in a statement.
South Africa plans to raise 2.5 billion rand by foreign issues in 1996/97 (April-March). Earlier this month it launched a seven-year 500 million mark bond.
Merrill Lynch has been appointed lead manager for the Yankee issue.
